title: Linglong Tou
synopsis:
Young Jin Heyi was suddenly jilted by her fiancé, Mu Li. It turned out that Mu Li had been appointed as a general and was about to go to the Great Swamp to help the emperor find treasure. Did he think she was no longer good enough for him after becoming a general? She hated treacherous men more than anything. So what if the Great Swamp was fraught with danger and monsters? She would cut her long hair, disguise herself as a man, and go and bring Mu Li back! If he wanted to break off the engagement, he had to explain himself clearly!

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
